title: Revisiting Overestimation Bias Problem of Q-learning: Settling Large Discrete Action Space via Action Intersection
abstract: arXiv:2608.12912v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper considers the overestimation bias problem of Q-learning in the setting of a large action space, for the purpose of relieving the bottleneck of existing methods. We find that the large action space increases the randomness in Q-value estimation. The randomness makes two paradigms that drive the major literature on the overestimation problem have their own bottlenecks: the coupling paradigm, i.e., the optimal action and its Q-value are estimated with the same Q-function, always has a positive bias. This is because randomness leads to some actions having abnormally high estimated values than their true values, and the coupling methods prefer these actions. The decoupling paradigm, i.e., the optimal action and its Q-value are estimated with two independent Q-functions, always has a negative bias. translated_title: 重访Q学习的过估计偏差问题：通过动作交集解决大规模离散动作空间
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12912v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：本文考虑在大规模动作空间设置下Q学习的过估计偏差问题，旨在缓解现有方法的瓶颈。我们发现，大规模动作空间增加了Q值估计中的随机性。这种随机性使得驱动过估计问题主要文献的两种范式各有其瓶颈：耦合范式，即最优动作及其Q值使用同一Q函数估计，总是存在正偏差。这是因为随机性导致某些动作的估计值异常高于其真实值，而耦合方法偏好这些动作。解耦范式，即最优动作及其Q值使用两个独立的Q函数估计，总是存在负偏差。这是因为随机性增加了同一动作在两个独立Q表之间的估计差距。本文表明，
tldr: 本文提出通过动作交集方法解决大规模动作空间中Q学习的过估计偏差问题，克服了耦合范式的正偏差和解耦范式的负偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an action intersection method to address the overestimation bias in Q-learning with large action spaces, overcoming positive bias in coupled paradigms and negative bias in decoupled paradigms.
